name: Langhof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Langhof is located in the municipality of Thiersee in Tirol. The house stands directly on the shore of the Thiersee. The surroundings are characterized by the Kaisergebirge and extensive forests. The amenities include a traditional dining room with regional cuisine. The rooms offer a view of the lake or the mountains. The atmosphere in the house is rural and quiet. The accommodation is frequently used by hikers and families. The inn serves as a starting point for excursions in the surrounding area.
